task: High-quality German language model training via aggressive filtering with repetition

key_results: PVM delivers consistent average accuracy gains across 4B and 8B model scales with negligible parameter overhead, particularly in complex reasoning tasks

key_results: T^2PO demonstrates substantial gains in training stability and performance improvements on WebShop, ALFWorld, and SearchQA with better exploration efficiency

title: Synaptic high-frequency jumping synchronises vision to high-speed behaviour
task: Determine how housefly visual system maintains accuracy during high-speed saccadic motion
key_results: Photoreceptor-LMC synapses sample ~2500 bits·s⁻¹ and transmit ~4100 bits·s⁻¹; synaptic high-frequency jumping extends bandwidth to ~1000 Hz; flies respond within ~13–20 ms, quadrupling flicker-fusion limits (~230 Hz)
comments: Remarkable findings on ultra-fast synaptic transmission, though the predictive mechanism invoked requires further validation beyond the biophysical model.

model_io.model: Intracellular and photomechanical recordings during saccade-like stimulation
inputs: visual stimuli with saccade-like motion profiles

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synaptic high-frequency jumping dynamically shifts transmission toward higher frequencies during saccades

hypotheses.hypothesis: Photomechanical-stochastic-refractory sampling co-adapts with saccadic behavior

hypotheses.hypothesis: YPEL5 maintains follicle pool and oocyte quality by regulating mitochondrial homeostasis and DNA damage responses

task: Characterize nonreciprocal superconducting critical currents and TRS breaking in kagome CsV3Sb5
key_results: Nonreciprocal critical current Ic at zero field; spontaneous TRS/inversion breaking; CDW state exhibits trainable field-dependent directionality
comments: Normal-state loop-current CDW with macroscopic TRS breaking trainable by magnetic field manifests as nonreciprocal superconducting properties.

hypotheses.hypothesis: CDW state in CsV3Sb5 breaks TRS with trainable macroscopic directionality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via field-dependent Ic asymmetry polarity; symmetry breaking persists into superconducting state

title: Charge density wave transition of pristine and organic-intercalated 1T-VSe2 studied by infrared spectroscopy
task: Characterize charge density wave transitions in VSe2 and TBA-intercalated VSe2
key_results: Pristine VSe2 shows gradual CDW gap development; TBA-intercalated VSe2 exhibits abrupt band reconstruction with first-order phase transition
comments: Infrared spectroscopy effectively distinguishes between traditional CDW order and fermi-surface-driven transitions across broad energy scales.

hypotheses.hypothesis: TBA intercalation introduces first-order phase transition with broad-energy band reconstruction

title: Chiral charge density wave in 1T- and 4Hb-TaS2: the role of interlayer coupling
task: Investigate chiral charge density wave domains in layered TaS2 polytypes
key_results: 4Hb-TaS2 exhibits coexisting left- and right-handed CDW domains with four distinct spectral patterns; interlayer coupling ~100× weaker than bulk 1T-TaS2
comments: Interlayer coupling strength critically determines CDW chirality uniformity; quasi-2D 4Hb-TaS2 provides tunable platform for chiral CDW phenomena.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Weak interlayer coupling in 4Hb-TaS2 permits coexisting chiral CDW domains
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via micro-ARPES revealing heterogeneous chirality and DFT showing ~100× weaker interlayer interaction

title: Advanced methodology for damping characterization of the human tympanic membrane using high-speed digital holography and STFT analysis
task: Quantify frequency-dependent damping in human tympanic membrane
key_results: Frequency-dependent effective system-level damping demonstrated with spatial variation across membrane; ossicular chain loading effect measured
comments: High-speed digital holography with STFT overcomes limitations of conventional time-domain analysis for multi-mode systems.

key_results: Output torque range increases from 0–3.8 Nm to 0–9.2 Nm with motor actuation; compact joint achieves passive/active stiffness regulation and locking function

task: Develop high-fidelity QND readout for bosonic cat-state qubits
key_results: Longitudinal readout achieves faster SNR growth and shorter measurement times than dispersive readout; squeezed input exponentially enhances SNR

title: Impact of wear position on dosimeter performance: measurement validity under simulated indoor illumination
task: Quantify dosimeter wear-position impact on personal light exposure measurement validity
key_results: Chest-worn deviations range −26.2% to 63.8%; overhead lighting deviations exceed 25%; lower chest position minimizes errors
comments: Rotational dosimeter displacement is dominant factor affecting measurement validity; individualized positioning recommended for reliable PLE quantification.

title: Impact of wear position on dosimeter performance: a hybrid measurement-simulation approach to quantify in-situ factors
task: Develop hybrid measurement-simulation approach to optimize light dosimeter placement on body
key_results: 0–46.4% of chest area exhibits suitable dosimeter positions depending on posture; three key factors (translational/rotational displacement, self-occlusion) quantified
comments: Individual body morphology and posture significantly influence optimal dosimeter placement; illustrative placement limits identified for valid PLE measurement.

title: Cross-species comparison of amniote single-cell transcriptomes reveals evolutionary conservation and divergence in the chicken immune system
task: Cross-species transcriptomic comparison of immune cells across amniotes
